name: How long does it take to fix a hot water leak under the floor?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a hot water leak under the floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to fix a hot water leak under the floor varies depending on the complexity of the leak and the chosen repair method. Leak detection itself can take a few hours. If direct access to the pipe is needed through a concrete slab, the repair might involve several hours to a full day for excavation, pipe repair, and patching. Re-routing a pipe can sometimes take longer, spanning one to two days. Factors like flooring type and accessibility also influence the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixing a hot water leak under the floor can take from a few hours to one or two days, depending on leak complexity and repair method.
